title: Aim Expert
description:
• Progress through unique arcade style challenges that will test your aim in all aspects. 

• Standard training modes will perfect all your skills from accuracy and speed to tracking and flicking. 

• The Scoring System will reward good habits. 

• The Rating System for completed challenges assigns a rating based on your performance. Everyone wants to see that Diamond rating. 

• Leaderboards displaying the best Aimers and their score in each game mode. 

• Achievements are ready to be collected at every corner.

Aim Expert is a skill based aiming simulator providing arcade style levels and standard aim training modes. Challenge yourself in all aspects of aiming and climb the leaderboards to showcase your skills.

Prepare for a challenging journey that will test but also sharpen your aiming skills.

Win or fail, it doesn't matter. Regular exercise of an activity or skill is the way to become proficient in it. 

Whether you're looking to have fun, trying to get a high score or take your aim to the next level, Aim Expert has something for everyone.
